Long DNA strands turn chaotic fluid motion into a steady rhythm
stories.t: In living cells, tiny molecules can generate coordinated motion across distances thousands of times larger than the molecules themselves. How such small movements give rise to coordinated motion over much larger distances is still not fully understood.
